description: Hashes of a text or base64 input (up to 1 MB): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512 and CRC-32, and HMAC-SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA-512 when a key is given. Hex and base64 output. MD5 and CRC-32 are implemented here and checked against RFC 1321 and the standard CRC test vector. Body { input, encoding, algorithms, key }. Pure code and WebCrypto, no outside request. Price: $0.001 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

algorithms.description: Comma-separated: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512, crc32, hmac-sha256, hmac-sha512 (default: all but the HMACs)

input.description: The text, or base64 when encoding is base64 (JSON body field)

key.description: Key for the HMAC algorithms, up to 1024 characters (JSON body field)

name: hash
title: Hash
